sources.author: legendsciber
patch_list: Coins and gems are always set to 2,147,483,647 whenever they are earned, spent, purchased, or loaded from a save.

Spoofs the installer source as Google Play for every install-source check in the game and its SDKs, so sideloaded installs are treated as store installs and installer-based Play Store redirects are bypassed.
